stem: Which of the following is/are the exclusive power(s) of Lok Sabha?
items: To ratify the declaration of Emergency
To pass a motion of no-confidence against the Council of Ministers
To impeach the President of India
prompt: Select the correct answer using the code given below:

ex.summary: Only the no-confidence motion is the Lok Sabha's alone: the Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the Lok Sabha (Article 75(3)). Approving an Emergency needs resolutions of both Houses (Article 352(4)), and the impeachment charge against the President may be preferred by either House (Article 61).

hook: The Lok Sabha-only power trap UPSC set in 2022

aarav.line: Emergency needs both Houses. So only 2. (b).

priya.line: Lok Sabha controls Emergency too. 1 and 2.

verdicts.p: Art 75(3): ministers collectively responsible to it.

points.p: Lok Sabha alone can disapprove it (Art 352(7)).
can authorise new All India Services (Art 312).

remember: Lok Sabha alone: no-confidence. Emergency: both Houses.
trap: Priya ticked 1: Lok Sabha alone can force an Emergency's end, but approving it needs both Houses.
method: Other House has any role? Then it's not exclusive.

bonus.short: In which matter does the Rajya Sabha have equal powers with the Lok Sabha?

reply_right: Only no-confidence: ministers are collectively responsible to Lok Sabha (Art 75(3)).
reply_trap: Emergency approval and impeachment both involve the Rajya Sabha too.
